_note: MINDTAIL Shorts (branch mindtail). Read by tools/mindtail.mjs, .github/workflows/mindtail.yml and the mindtail-script / mindtail-edit skills. Separate from config/daily.json (the news channel).
brief: MINDTAIL Hindi Short, 9:16, curious documentary style: a narrator uncovering how the mind works. Strict reel template: HOOK (0-3 s: the most surprising line, a title over clear footage, an impact SFX on frame 0, fastest cuts) -> BODY (setup, escalation, a reveal every few seconds, a whoosh on each new idea, a riser into the key reveal) -> END (the payoff line after a short silence, a hit, the music resolving, a closing question on screen). Picture: about 85% clear, fully visible stock footage (no dark layer, no blur): real video clips mixed with photos that move (slow zoom in/out, pans), whip/flash transitions on beats, small animated callouts (keyword chips, underline/circle annotations, a number roll for a number the voice says). Broadcast look, karaoke Hindi captions with yellow #FFD700 key words. One CC0 bed (mysterious/curious), ducked under the voice; SFX clearly audible. No intro, no logo, no outro.
topics: why the brain does what it does (habits, memory, attention, fear, decisions)
psychology effects and cognitive biases in everyday life
human behaviour: groups, crowds, friends, strangers, social pressure
dark psychology explained responsibly: manipulation patterns and how to spot them
mysteries of the mind: dreams, deja vu, sleep, consciousness, strange real cases
the phone, social media and the brain
relationships and emotions: trust, jealousy, loneliness, why people change

youtube._note: No YouTube upload on this branch until the owner says so. MINDTAIL needs its own YouTube login; the YT_* secrets belong to 24 Hours in Tech.

_transcriptionNote: align = free MMS forced alignment of the *_voiceover.txt to the audio (tools/align/align.py): no ElevenLabs key or credits. elevenlabs = Scribe (paid).
_topicsNote: Every MINDTAIL Short must connect to the mind or human behaviour (the channel name). Animal or random trivia only when it says something about the human mind.
